volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

frequency.tooltip: Hz. Self-osc pitch is referenced at Resonance 0.8. MOD adds Hz.

dither.tooltip: On mixes a noise band highpassed at Frequency and lowpassed at 4×Frequency into the inner oscillator. Start / Full / Amount set the mix.

start.tooltip: Frequency where the noise-band mix begins. Below this the inner oscillator stays clean.

full.tooltip: Frequency where the noise-band mix reaches Amount. Log ramp between Start and Full.

amount.tooltip: Noise-band mix at Full. 0 = inner oscillator only. 1 = replace with the ƒ…4ƒ band.

seed.tooltip: Chaos + cycle-dither seed. Same Seed = same output; new modules get their own.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center / 50%. Affects Trisaw, Analog Square (same-direction peaks), Trisaw Center (opposing peaks toward saw), Pulse, and Center Square (pulse grows from mid-cycle — not a stepped square). Morph MOD jack on the param row.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Post-MOD stays in min…max (Gate+Toggle cannot boost past Amp max).

softenAttack.tooltip: 0…1 = Attack 0…0.02 s. KT (MIDI 0…127) unit-mods that span: −10% at 0, −41.25% at 127.

tail.tooltip: How long the pluck rings. Higher = longer. Inverted breadboard Dampen (0 = shortest, 2.2 = longest).

synthVsAcoustic.tooltip: DC offset on the inverted-env → expo → Release path. Higher = more acoustic linger.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: Latch: freeze Soften Attack on rising Trigger (release fold from Tail / Synth stays live). Free: knobs always live.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

pulseStart.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes high. Quantized to whole samples.

pulseEnd.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes low. Quantized to whole samples.

pulseMode.tooltip: 0 Forward (one-way). 0.5 out-and-back, peak at 50% of the pulsing window. 1 Reverse-Forward (peak at the start). In between, the peak walks from the end of the window toward the start.

antialiasing.tooltip: Off: first sample at or after each time. Random: seed-locked 0/+1 on stacked pulses. Dither: ±1 around the true time (Robin1).

wave.tooltip: Trigger: single-sample pulses. Gate: 50% high between pulses. Saw/Ramp: naive ramp from one pulse to the next. TriSaw/Sine: one cycle starting and ending at 0. Pulse Left/Center/Right: -1/+1 pulse. Rect Sine: zero-mean |sin| hump. Each grain starts at a pulse and ends at the next.

seed.tooltip: Locks the antialiasing pattern. Same Seed = same offsets on every trigger. Change Seed for a different noise texture.

count.tooltip: Pulses in the train (one-way). Slider 1–128; type above the slider for denser trains (DSP up to 16384).

inputGain.tooltip: Drive into the limiter before detect/GR. Raise to hit Threshold harder (more pump).

threshold.tooltip: Level where gain reduction starts. Lower = more compression/pump on typical program.

ratio.tooltip: How hard GR climbs above Threshold. ~4–8 = firm. ~12–20 = heavy pump.

lookaheadEnabled.tooltip: How early the detector hears the hit. The audio is delayed by this much, and Attack uses that head start. Off = gain moves on the sample itself.

lookaheadMs.tooltip: Look-ahead delay in ms when Look-ahead is On. Part of the sound (not host-compensated).

lookaheadSamples.tooltip: Extra look-ahead in samples (added to LA Time). Hidden by default.

attack.tooltip: How long gain takes to finish falling after a hit is seen. If this is shorter than Look-ahead, the fall finishes before the hit plays and the output stays at Threshold. If this is longer, the hit can still poke through.

hold.tooltip: How long gain reduction is held after it stops deepening, before Release starts. A new peak restarts the hold. 0 = release right away.

release.tooltip: How fast gain recovers after a hit — the main pump/breathe timing. Longer = slower swell back.

amplitude.tooltip: Final output trim after GR. 0…1. Lower if the bus is too hot; no autogain.

algorithm.tooltip: Snare design. 808: two pinged resonators + high-passed noise. 909: two phase-reset rounded triangles + two noise bands. Simmons: SDS-V style sine with bend + resonant-lowpassed noise + click. FM: Chowning 1:1.4 FM drum + noise. Knobs keep their values when you switch.

tune.tooltip: Rest pitch of the body. 808: low resonator (high = x1.93). 909: VCO1 (VCO2 = x1.72). Simmons: oscillator. FM: carrier (modulator = x1.4).

tone.tooltip: Timbre. 808: low <-> high resonator mix (panel Tone). 909: noise lowpass 2 -> 12 kHz (brighter). Simmons: noise resonant lowpass 300 Hz -> 12 kHz. FM: peak FM index 0 -> 8.

snappy.tooltip: Snare-wire noise amount. 808: noise envelope level (panel Snappy). 909: level of both noise bands (panel Snappy). Simmons: noise <-> tone balance. FM: noise level.

bodyDecay.tooltip: How long the tonal body rings: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60). 808: low resonator (high 0.31x). 909: VCO1 envelope (VCO2 0.6x). Simmons: shared VCA (noise and tone). FM: carrier and FM index.

snapDecay.tooltip: How long the noise rings: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60). 808 / FM: noise envelope. 909: main noise band (this is the 909 panel's Tone). Simmons: extra noise envelope inside the VCA (at or above Body Decay = stock SDS-V).

bend.tooltip: Pitch drop at the hit: starts this many octaves above Tune and falls back. 0 = stock 808. 808 / 909 / FM: ~20 ms drop (909 ~0.5 oct). Simmons: falls over half the Body Decay (1-2 oct).

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Does not scale Env.

offset.tooltip: Bias. Off/On choices by default. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

waveform.tooltip: Naive source into Morph. Dither mixes a noise band from ƒ to 4ƒ (no period grain). Asym Sine is 2× per wrap; phasor runs at ƒ/2. Sine is sin(2πφ) at ƒ.

morph.tooltip: 0 = dark (~0.5×ƒ one-pole cascade). 1 = open (~100×ƒ, clamped to Nyquist). Makeup holds the fundamental.

poles.tooltip: One-pole cascade depth for Morph. 1 = 6 dB/oct, 4 = 24 dB/oct toward sine-ish.

dither.tooltip: Off = clean PolyBLEP. On = mix in a noise band highpassed at ƒ and lowpassed at 4ƒ. Pitch stays locked (no ±1-sample grain). Start / Full / Amount set the mix.

start.tooltip: ƒ where the noise-band mix begins. Below this the oscillator stays a clean PolyBLEP.

full.tooltip: ƒ where the noise-band mix reaches Amount. Log ramp between Start and Full.

amount.tooltip: Noise-band mix at Full. 0 = still the PolyBLEP. 1 = replace with the ƒ…4ƒ band.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD).

phase.tooltip: Phase offset in cycles. Reset snaps Wave to this offset.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave.

seed.tooltip: Dither noise seed. Same Seed = same output; new modules get their own.

offset.tooltip: Bias. The face edits this. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.
